sources: Amaranthine Tassel (WeaponBasicTable wpn_claym_0017, greatsword; Mi Fu's signature). Its Strength and ATK lines and sk_wpn_claym_0017's Physical DMG +phy_dmg_up (cardAttributeModifier attr 50) are on the stat panel. Skill 3 "Combative: Amaranthine Cleave", rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_claym_0017 passiveEventActions, values from SkillPatchTable at the weapon's skill-3 level (level 9: phy_spell_up 84, duration 20 s, phy_dmg_up2 0.252, atk_up_mult 0.084, duration2 30 s). Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0031_mifu.md rows E1–E7.

abilityEvent 206 (the wielder applies a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1, tag query 1066759270 (Physical Susceptibility: buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_physical and _all; its ID list holds one empty entry) → buff_wpn_claym_0017_dmgup on the wielder: "When the wielder applies Physical Susceptibility, the wielder gains Arts Intensity +{phy_spell_up} for {duration}s".

abilityEvent 401 (the wielder applies a physical status) + CheckPhysicalInflictionType mask 8 (Crush) + CheckBuffStackNumAdvanced Vulnerable (tag 1075718177) ≥ 1 on the target → count = its Vulnerable stacks (SaveBuffStackNumAdvanced, before the Crush consumes them), phy_dmg_up_final = phy_dmg_up2 + atk_up_mult × count → buff_wpn_claym_0017_dmgup2: "Physical DMG Dealt +[{phy_dmg_up2} + ({atk_up_mult} × Max number of Vulnerability stacks consumed from one enemy)] for {duration2}s". A Crush on a target without Vulnerable only adds a stack: no physicalStatus event (status.ts), so nothing, as the ≥ 1 check says.
toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01 (atk_up, a key sk_wpn_claym_0017 doesn't have): a template leftover with no effect, as Ancient Canal's.

buffs.label: Amaranthine Cleave: Arts Intensity
buffs.note: BuffData buff_wpn_claym_0017_dmgup: attribute 87 (Arts Intensity) phy_spell_up; stackingType 4 with priority key lv (the loader reads it from the game buff: a reapplication refreshes).

buffs.label: Amaranthine Cleave: Physical DMG after a Crush
buffs.note: BuffData buff_wpn_claym_0017_dmgup2: attribute 50 (Physical DMG) phy_dmg_up_mult, assigned phy_dmg_up_final; stackingType 1 with a priority key, maxStackCnt 2: the loader keeps up to two instances and only the strongest acts ("do not stack with themselves", batch-3 B1). Its value is taken at the event: 0.504 after a 3-stack Crush, 0.588 after a 4-stack one at level 9.

triggers.note: abilityEvent 206 with the tag query (the loader maps 1066759270 to Susceptibility reaching Physical; an all-element one counts, as the tag on _all says). No CheckOriginSkillType: any of the wielder's skills.

The event's level is the stacks the Crush consumed ({eventCount}). beforeDamage: abilityEvent 401 comes with the status, before its damage (buff_physical_do_crushed) and the applying hit's, so both carry the bonus (Ancient Canal's reading; in-game test 51).
